# Code of Conduct

Cadence is a small open-source project. The rules here are short and practical, and they apply to every project space — issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages, and any other channel tied to the repository.

## What we expect

- Be respectful. Disagree on ideas, not on people.
- Assume good faith. Most friction online is a misread tone, not malice.
- Keep feedback specific and actionable. "This is bad" helps no one; "this breaks on X because Y" does.
- Stay on topic in issues, PRs, and discussions.
- Respect the time of maintainers and other contributors. Search before asking; read the linked docs before opening an issue.

## What is not welcome

- Personal attacks, harassment, or sustained disruption.
- Discriminatory language or behavior of any kind.
- Sharing someone else's private information without their consent.
- Deliberately derailing threads or spamming.

## Reporting

If you see behavior that breaks this policy, email **raphael.leminor@gmail.com** with a short description and links to the relevant threads. Reports are handled privately.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove content that breaks this policy, and may block repeat offenders from the project. Decisions are made case by case and communicated to the people involved.
